_comment: District 5 (GDD §4.1 chain order), Act II gate district. Prereq verified in data/districts/district_hospital.tres: powered_by = [&"residential"]; hospital powers warehouses (district_warehouses.tres). Threat roster (scripts/enemies/enemy_pool.gd): watcher, shadow, crawler — watcher leads here, so the light-discipline lesson from school is assumed known and raised: this district's axis is supply, not stealth teaching. Themed loot canon (district_loot.gd BY_DISTRICT): medkit, medkit, serum, fabric, alcohol — hospital is the game's medicine bank. No blueprint (district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS = residential/park/police/warehouses). Story doc canon: doc_hospital_note (patient N from substation Ж-3, 'the light is a door'). Puzzle canon: puzzle_system.gd generator_hospital (reward medkit, power_stage 2). Repair-part guarantee mirrors district_loot.gd REPAIR_PARTS (2x cable/fuse/transistor). All item ids verified against data/items/*.tres (41 ids, 2026-09).

fixed_spawns.reason: Guarantee: cable for PARTIAL. Grid-crew leftovers by the diesel plant desk (hospital_note_05); room is unlocked from the bay ramp.
Guarantee: fuse for STREETS. Corridor cabinet, no lock — the corridor is walkable in DARK per hospital_note_03's rule.
Guarantee: transistor for FULL. Pharmacy is locked; opened by hospital_fix_key_01 — no lockpick required (R1).
Pharmacy key in the reception night-drawer, where the duty nurse would leave it. Reachable in DARK with zero tools.
Ward trolley left mid-round; the district's promise (medicine bank) must pay out even at DARK.
Single guaranteed serum behind the pharmacy lock from PARTIAL — the reward for solving the key chain.
Surgical spirit crate: themed material (BY_DISTRICT) and molotov feedstock without handing out molotovs.
Linen cart; pairs with hospital_fix_craft_01 for bandage/molotov crafting.
Defense cache at the south gate toward the warehouses road; STREETS stage only.
Battery top-up on arrival from residential; the whole district is interior and flashlight-dependent.

rules: R1: In DARK, fixed_spawns alone must cover the repair chain (>=2 cable, >=2 fuse, >=2 transistor); the pharmacy key (hospital_fix_key_01) sits in an unlocked reception drawer, so the transistors are reachable with zero lockpicks and zero rolled loot.

R2: Rolled loot never includes stage-gated items early: table lookup uses the CURRENT DistrictData.Stage only. Serum enters the rolls at PARTIAL (weight 3) and only becomes common at FULL — hospital is where the serum economy starts, it must not flood earlier districts' balance.
R3: Fixed spawns are one-time per save; rolls are per-container with container_modifiers on qty.
R4: No firearms in hospital (molotov/noise_bomb remain the ceiling). Alcohol + fabric are handed out as crafting feedstock instead of finished weapons.

R5: Supply economy, not stealth teaching: the rich containers (pharmacy_cabinet 1.6, supply_trolley 1.3) sit in the two rooms with a single entrance and no cover — pharmacy and operating theatre. Corridor and bay containers are poor but safe. A player who never enters a dead-end room still finishes the district via R1.
R6: Pharmacy and morgue caches must not roll empty — both are scripted caches, not RNG (mirrors park's keeper-shed and school's shelter rule).

R7: Act II gate: lore notes hospital_note_06/07/08 must not spawn before STREETS (min_stage 2) — they carry the Project Architect reveal (GDD §12.3, CONTENT_WORLD_BIBLE rule 3). The loot spawner must respect min_stage on notes, not only on items.
R8: No blueprint spawns in hospital (district_loot.gd BLUEPRINTS canon).
